messages:
incident-bot: AUTO-PAGE fired — canary pool 'inference-canary-4' in eu-west-1 exceeded error-rate threshold (15%) for model 'open-redwood-small'. PagerDuty incident INC-33700 created.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-33700 — High error rate on canary. Triggered by alert 'canary_errors_eu_west1'. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-33700

oncall-ryan: ack
oncall-ryan: I'm the on-call for the hour, taking ownership. What's current customer impact?

maria: quick snapshot — 5xx spike started ~2m ago, p95 latency for /v1/generate up from 180ms -> 1.2s. ~3% of traffic routed to canary pool.
maria: logs show repeated `runtime/kvcache: invalidation flood` and `decoder: kvfetch timeout` around the same time

kevin: looks like the new quant kernel in v1.43 might be triggering KV fetch latencies. recommendation: rollback canary to v1.42 and halt rollout.

sam: initiating rollback now. running:
```
kubectl --context=eu-west-1 rollout undo deployment/inference-canary-4 --namespace=redwood-inference
kubectl --context=eu-west-1 scale deployment/inference-canary-4 --replicas=0 --namespace=redwood-inference
```

sam: started at host runner-12, pods terminating

maria: product/CS says there are two support tickets referencing 503s (SUP-9995, SUP-9996). low volume but visible.

product-jen: noted. Not P0 customers but definitely affecting some power users. Keep me posted for a postmortem action item list.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: INC-33700 status -> acknowledged by oncall-ryan. Auto-escalation paused.

sre-rotation: tagging for follow-up: telemetry, kvcache, kernel-quant. I'll file a follow-up ticket after stabilization.

kevin: after rollback, running quick smoke against canary endpoint: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://eu-west-1.api.redwood/v1/generate`
kevin: smoke shows 200 0.21s now for the control pool

oncall-ryan: rollback completed and verified. p95 returned to baseline after ~4m. I'll keep monitoring for 20m before closing.

maria: capturing timeline and logs to S3: s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-33700/

product-jen: please add affected customer ids and support ticket links to the postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident INC-33700 -> resolved (auto) — condition cleared and canary error rate back under threshold. Marking as resolved after oncall confirmation.

oncall-ryan: confirming resolved. closing thread. :thumbsup:

sre-rotation: created follow-up ticket WF-1192 for kernel/kv investigation and roll strategy. assigning kevin/maria.

maria: thanks — will start a narrow repro run on a staging cluster and loop in infra tooling for telemetry correlation.

oncall-ryan: final note — no data-loss, no customer-facing rollback needed beyond canary. handing back to rotation. end.
